messages:
sarah.docs: FYI opened a docs PR to correct the API ref for /v1/rerank. examples currently show `items: [\"text\"]` and `score: 1` (int). runtime actually expects `candidates: [{id, text}]` in the request and returns `score: 0.91` (float). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1155

ben.eng: yikes  did that get into the published site? can you paste the bad vs good curl so i can run a quick smoke test against staging?

sarah.docs: bad (current site):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"model": "redwood/reranker", "items": ["option a", "option b"]}'
```
fixed (canonical request):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"model_id": "redwood/reranker", "candidates": [{"id": "a1","text": "option a"},{"id": "b2","text": "option b"}], "query": "Which is more concise?"}'
```

lucy.sdk: noted. our Go example and Python snippet diverged here; Go used `items` and Python used `candidates`. SDKs map both, but docs should show `candidates` and `score` as a float in the response example. i'll open SDK PR to standardize examples across languages and add a one-line compat note.

nina.prod: please add a short migration note at the top of the API ref: \"If you previously sent `items` (string array) switch to `candidates` (array of objects). Response `score` is normalized float [0.0-1.0].\" we'll include this in the release notes and give CS a heads-up.

link-checker: docs/link-check failed in docs/pull/1155  broken anchor to /sdk/go#examples.

ben.eng: ran the fixed curl against staging  200 OK, response sample below, i'll paste into the PR as the approved example:
```json
{"choices": [{"id": "a1", "text": "Option A", "score": 0.9123}, {"id": "b2", "text": "Option B", "score": 0.0877}], "model_id": "redwood/reranker"}
```

sarah.docs: perfect. i'll update the OpenAPI snippet to show `candidates: array<object>`, `score: number`, and swap `model` -> `model_id` in examples. will also add the migration blurb and a short note in the SDK snippets about compatibility.

lucy.sdk: will coordinate PRs so docs and SDK land together after the link fix. thanks for the staging sample — super helpful.

sarah.docs: tracking: docs PR 1155 (schema + examples), sdk PR 521 (snippets), follow-up changelog entry. ping here once link-checker is green and ben completes the smoke test.
